Preparing a shared workshop

The workshop guide explains how volunteers can record configuration changes and keep the equipment ready for another team.

Everyone should be able to understand the previous decisions before making changes to the tools or the shared schedule.

Practical advice

Consider these approaches

  1. Keep a local copy of the working configuration so every administrator can inspect the settings before the next upgrade.

  2. Record changes in a shared log so another volunteer can reproduce the result and explain differences during a later review.
